extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and format requirements for preparing the NIH biographical sketch for senior/key personnel and significant contributors, including required sections (Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, Research Support) and the Education/Training table. Emphasizes format, ordering, and a five-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch overall format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified biosketch format for each individual; the entire biographical sketch must not exceed five pages. The document includes distinct labeled sections (A. Personal Statement; B. Positions and Honors; C. Contributions to Science; D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance) and identification fields (NAME, eRA COMMONS USER NAME, POSITION TITLE).

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME: eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login): POSITION TITLE:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, their eRA Commons user name or equivalent credential, and the current position title at the top of the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a table including the following columns: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY. Start with the baccalaureate or other initial professional education and include subsequent training (residency, postdoctoral); add or delete rows as needed to reflect the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise narrative that summarizes the individual's expertise, career focus, and relevance to the proposed project. Use this section to explain how the person's experience and resources will support the proposal (e.g., mentoring role, specific methodological expertise, access to center resources). The page shows examples where the Personal Statement highlights long-term research focus, team science, and specific contributions to the proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment history chronologically with dates and institutional affiliations. Separately list honors, awards, and professional recognitions with dates. The example shows detailed chronological listings of appointments, directorships, consulting roles, and honors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the most significant scientific contributions in narrative form (numbered items are used in the example). For each contribution, provide a brief explanatory paragraph of its impact and include representative peer-reviewed publications (the example uses lettered citations a., b., c., etc.). Clarify the individual's role (e.g., PI, thought leader, collaborator) and, when relevant, note team-science context and shared contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Ongoing and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance / Ongoing Research Support / Completed Research Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List current and completed research support with project title, funding source, role (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, Site PI), project dates, and concise description of aims and the individual's responsibilities. The example entries include grant numbers, project aims, start and end dates, and role statements (e.g., 'Role: Co-Investigator; Responsible for MRI protocol design, acquisition and analysis').
